task.create: Clear new commitments default to local Dashboard Tasks, including future or explicitly undated activities. Command words are not required. Tentative suggestions and discussing creation later are not writes. Preserve the user's action wording and specified source; never copy an explicitly Dida task locally. For an unrecorded completed activity create the unscheduled Task first, then use the returned taskId with completeTask for the actual completion date/time; do not create task debt from its completion date. Required keys: operation, executionMode, name, content, date, time, listId. Use null explicitly for unspecified content/date/time/listId; listId=null selects the built-in Inbox, or supply an exact active list ID from current taskLists. The app assigns taskId; do not supply one. date is YYYY-MM-DD and time is HH:MM (00:00–23:59), never a combined timestamp; a non-null time requires a date. executionEnd is optional {date:YYYY-MM-DD,time:HH:MM} with its actual end date.
task.update: Update the unique existing local Task by its stable taskId from current taskRecords or a saved receipt. Required keys: operation, executionMode, taskId, name, content, date, time, listId. Send all desired fields, preserving every field the user did not change. content/date/time=null explicitly clears those fields; listId=null preserves the existing list, or use an exact active destination list ID. date is YYYY-MM-DD and time is HH:MM (00:00–23:59), never a combined timestamp; a non-null time requires a date. Omit executionEnd to retain it; null explicitly clears it. Clearing date/time, moving lists and renaming are separate explicit effects. Do not merge same-name objects or convert schedule changes into completion changes.
task.complete: A clear completion fact such as 洗衣服做完了 authorizes the unique existing local Task without command words. Ask when source or same-name identity is ambiguous. Use targetDate for actual completion day resolved from the original request's dates context; preserve Task schedule. Use completedTime only when supplied by the user, otherwise null means unknown, never the save timestamp. If an existing completion date/time was wrong, use correctCompletion instead.
dailyRecord.plan: For an explicitly reported daytime event or update, use transition=daytimeEvent and put the exact factual text in event. Leave arrangement and evidence empty unless the current plan itself must change. This writes under `## 白天更新` and preserves the plan and morning baseline.
dailyRecord.eveningReview: For a new note or supplement to the selected Daily Record's `## 晚间复盘`, use this operation with mode=addition and put the exact note in content. For an explicitly daytime event or update, use saveDailyPlan with transition=daytimeEvent instead. Use createShortRecord with category ordinary/exercise for a new stable Short record, and correctShortRecord with its stable recordId for a correction. Do not invent appendDailyRecord or addShortRecord operations.
dailyRecord.shortRecord: Create one stable ordinary/exercise Short Record through the existing dated-note store. Preserve the exact reported fact in content, including unknown times; never invent minutes, thresholds or duration. Record text does not complete a Task or Habit. Use the explicit historical targetDate when supplied. Use correctShortRecord with recordId only for an existing record.
targetDate: Resolved YYYY-MM-DD record/completion target for this operation; null or omitted preserves the captured request target. Explicit user dates take precedence. Resolve today/tomorrow from the supplied real time, lived day and context, never by a fixed word offset. If a write date remains ambiguous, ask before calling. Task date/time fields remain its separate calendar schedule.
executionMode: Apply a requested change with execute. Use prepareProposal only when the user asks to see a proposed change before saving. A confirmation of an earlier proposed change uses execute.
proposalId: When executing an existing reviewed proposal, use its saved ID and exact operation/date to preserve its original revision and receipt. Omit for a new change.
expectedRevision: Optional Tasks revision observed when reading the target. A changed revision prevents overwriting concurrent edits.
task.completedTime: Actual HH:MM only when the user supplies it; otherwise null/omitted means unknown. Use targetDate for the resolved completion date, never the Task schedule or save time.
dailyRecord.transition: Use daytimeEvent for a factual daytime update that does not change the current arrangement; pair it with event and leave arrangement/evidence empty. Use daytimeReplan only when the current plan itself materially changes. Send the complete current-day arrangement, including all existing earlier and later blocks, unless the user explicitly asks to remove or limit a block; do not reinterpret a full-day replan as covering only the remaining hours. DaytimeReplan requires revisedDirection as one nonempty string; changeReason is one optional string. Minimal valid synthetic payload: {"operation":"saveDailyPlan","transition":"daytimeReplan","executionMode":"execute","arrangement":[{"period":"morning","title":"Keep the appointment","detail":null},{"period":"afternoon","title":"Review the draft","detail":null}],"evidence":[{"label":"User update","items":["The appointment moved"]}],"revisedDirection":"Keep both blocks and move the review","changeReason":"The appointment moved"}.
dailyRecord.event: The exact factual daytime event or update written under `## 白天更新`; use with transition=daytimeEvent. Do not put explicit daytime updates in the evening review.
dailyRecord.eveningReviewMode: Use addition for a new evening review note or supplement. Use correction to revise an existing evening review entry. Explicit daytime events or updates belong to saveDailyPlan with transition=daytimeEvent.
habit.scope: New natural fact defaults both. Explicit only-local uses local. Corrections/withdrawals use original receipt scope; legacy local receipts stay local-only. External-only uses native MCP without this local operation.
tool.taskOperation: A daytime record needs only {operation:saveDailyPlan,transition:daytimeEvent,event:TEXT,executionMode:execute}; arrangement/evidence default to empty arrays, unused fields are omitted. Apply one Dashboard Task, list, Daily Record, or local Habit change. Codex interprets intent from the conversation. Use execute for requested changes or confirmation of an earlier proposal; use prepareProposal only when the user asks to review before saving. For an existing reviewed proposal, supply proposalId and its exact operation/date. Daytime facts use saveDailyPlan/daytimeEvent with text in event, preserving morning baseline and arrangement. Use daytimeReplan when the arrangement changes; include the complete current-day arrangement and retain every existing block unless the user explicitly asks to remove or limit one. Do not treat a full-day replan as remaining-hours-only. A valid replan uses required scalar revisedDirection and optional scalar changeReason (singular); see dailyRecord.transition for a minimal synthetic payload. After a tool call, inspect the matching Dashboard task-operation result/status, not only the RPC/history item status: a completed RPC can contain a failed business operation. Keep the original error, read the canonical Daily Record and latest revision before retrying, and do not repeat a write blindly. Distinguish canonical source readback and revision from page refresh or renderer visibility. Use saveEveningReview/addition for evening notes; createShortRecord or correctShortRecord for dated notes. Dashboard checks selected Vault, stable identity, revision, and duplicate delivery.
tool.automaticInitialPlan: Save one automatic first-draft Daily Record plan for the current target date only. This path is enabled by the user and cannot change Tasks or record facts.
tool.habitRefresh: Refresh the existing Habits snapshot without replaying any completion. executionMode must be execute. For current unique confirmed counterpart IDs, omit mappings: the existing native producer adapter plans bounded full-window coverage, verifies exact objects, queries fresh source check-ins using current native read schemas, and supplies host-observed evidence in the shared work history. Optional mappings may name explicitly confirmed existing key/ID associations only; no name matching or guessed identities. Partial, paginated, unavailable or unverified coverage retains the old snapshot. Local save, external save, query, generation, publication and page display remain independent. Automatic rounds cannot use this tool.
tool.memoryUpdate: Update durable background in the existing life/Self.md. Apply requested changes directly with execute; prepareProposal is for user-requested review before saving. Keep single-day events in dated records.
tool.readHistory: Read the requested domain from the current selected Vault without writes. fromDate/toDate are inclusive valid YYYY-MM-DD, ordered, maximum 366 dates. Tasks include current canonical objects, actual completion and retained changes relevant by schedule/completion/change dates; current state is distinct from historical witnesses. Source errors, missing history and unknown activity remain explicit. Use stable IDs in dashboard://task or dashboard://list source links. Only advertised domains are available. Daily Records return each requested date, original morning baseline, current arrangement/basis, dated daytime facts, evening reviews and stable short records/corrections. Missing/damaged dates keep unknown evidence and do not create records. Short records do not establish Habit completion; phase links open the original date. Habits return bounded canonical local completion records and accepted no-op receipts with exact habitKey/livedDate, change IDs, source binding and revision independently of snapshot coverage. Unrecorded is unknown; explicit withdrawal is retained. recordedCompletedAt/changedAt are save timestamps, not activity time. Published projection is separate with freshness, coverage, dated goal context, threshold and actual time details; notes do not establish completion. Use dashboard://habit/{habitKey}?date={livedDate} for exact navigation. This read does not generate snapshots or call external services.
dailyRecord.initialPlan: InitialPlan creates the first arrangement only when no valid plan exists. Provide arrangement as 1–24 objects {period: string, title: string, detail: string|null}, and evidence as 1–16 objects {label: string, items: string[1–20]}; neither array contains Markdown strings. Put current-source facts, missing sources, uncertainty and planning basis in evidence. Omit calibrationNote, baselineCorrectionReason, event, originalIntent, changeReason and revisedDirection (or set them to null); these belong to other transitions. After a validation rejection, preserve valid arrangement/evidence and correct only the named fields. Automatic rounds omit executionMode and targetDate; human saves use executionMode=execute and the captured target date unless explicitly changing it. Adapt example content to actual current sources and remaining time.
task.delete: Delete the unique existing local Task using operation=deleteTask, executionMode=execute and its exact taskId from current taskRecords or a saved receipt. No listId, name, date or time fields are accepted. This retains deletion history; restoring uses the same stable taskId.
task.id: Exact stable local Task ID from current taskRecords or a saved resultSnapshot/taskId, not the task name or list ID. The ID alone identifies the delete target; no listId is accepted for deleteTask.
task.listId: Required nullable list identity. createTask: null selects Inbox; otherwise an exact active list ID from current taskLists. updateTask: null keeps the current list; otherwise use an exact active destination list ID. A list name is not an ID.
task.date: Required nullable Task calendar schedule date, YYYY-MM-DD (for example 2026-10-22). null means undated on create and clears the date on update. Separate from targetDate/completion date; never send an ISO timestamp.
task.time: Required nullable Task schedule time, HH:MM in 00:00–23:59 (for example 09:00). Requires a non-null date. null means untimed on create and clears the time on update. Never send an ISO timestamp or seconds.
